forward_scope.reduction_service_reuse: The RMSNorm and Add-RMSNorm sources instantiate the same CUB float/1024 reduction with runtime blockDim.x valid count and the same variance division, epsilon, rsqrtf, shared publication, and block barrier. The installed sm_80 RMSNorm kernel uses 24 registers per thread and 168 bytes of static shared memory per CTA; the installed BF16 vec8 Add-RMSNorm kernel uses 32 registers per thread and the same 168 bytes of static shared memory per CTA. Both admit two 1024-thread CTAs per SM, while Add-RMSNorm admits eight 256-thread CTAs per SM, so the reduction service occupancy boundaries remain unchanged.
limitations: The source-bound L2 transaction and CTA-pipeline contract is restricted to hidden sizes divisible by 256.
The evidence transfers only the independently measured reduction/publication mechanism; it does not consume or transfer a production RMSNorm duration.

The six source-language BF16 conversions per element are recorded as a static fact but are not assigned to the generic integer ALU resource; a direction-specific independent conversion service is not yet available.
The 32 active read warps in each CTA do not prove that two resident CTAs simultaneously expose 64 independent L2 request producers, so Forward retains its one-CTA producer bound.
FP16 and non-1024-thread RMSNorm launches remain outside this contract.
